mythology: Sati's eyes fell here; later born as divine queen Tadaatagai (Meenakshi) from sacrificial fire of King Malayadhwaja Pandya, She conquered the quarters and wed Lord Sundareswarar.
pilgrimage_significance: Spiritual epicenter of Tamil culture and Shaiva-Shakta harmony; here Goddess Meenakshi receives the first puja before Lord Sundareswarar.
historical_notes: Focal center around which the concentric lotus-plan grid city of Madurai was historically laid out; eulogized by Thirugnanasambandar and countless Tamil poets.
